full_text:
Article 3 (Attendance at Meetings)
(1) In order to facilitate the operation of councils, public officials of relevant central administrative agencies may attend meetings of Capital Area Councils and Metropolitan Area Councils, while public officials of relevant Special Metropolitan Cities, Consolidated Special Cities, Metropolitan Cities, Special Self-Governing Cities, Do and Special Self-Governing Provinces may attend meetings of other councils. <Amended on November 16, 2015; and April 2, 2026.>
(2) Relevant heads of Si, Gun and autonomous Gu may attend meetings of Capital Area Councils and Metropolitan Area Councils, submit relevant materials and state their opinions. <Amended on April 2, 2026.>
